{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify the number of sites
num_sites = len(data_dedup['site'].unique())

# Compute response rate per site
table = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].mean().round(4)

# Compute patient counts and responders per site
patient_counts = data_dedup['site'].value_counts().sort_index()
responders = data_dedup.groupby('site')['responded'].sum().sort_index()

# Print the required numbers
print(f'Number of sites: {num_sites}')
print(f'Unique sites: {sorted(data_dedup["site"].unique())}')
print(f'Response rates by site:\n{table}')
print(f'Patient counts by site:\n{patient_counts}')
print(f'Responders by site:\n{responders}')

# Print the total number of patients after deduplication
print(f'Total patients after deduplication: {len(data_dedup)}')"}
